summary: Lead management app with payment workflow support: payment status tracking, notes, and data export

existing_features.title: Update the LeadDetailDialog component to display and allow editing of the new payment status field. Show status as a dropdown selector with Pending/Paid/Failed options, with appropriate color coding (yellow for Pending, green for Paid, red for Failed).
Update the LeadDetailDialog component to display and allow editing of the notes field. Show as a multi-line textarea with at least 4 rows of height.
Include payment status and notes fields in all data export formats (CSV, Excel, PDF-ready HTML, RTF/DOCX). Add these as new columns in the leads section of exports.
Update the LeadCard component to display a payment status badge when present. Show badge with appropriate color and position it prominently alongside the existing status badge.
Add payment status as a filterable option on the LeadsPage. Include a payment status filter dropdown alongside existing status and niche filters.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add payment status field to customer records (Pending/Paid/Failed)
Add notes/comments field for tracking payment conversations
Add a payment status field to the Lead data model with three possible values: Pending, Paid, and Failed. Store this as an optional variant type in the backend.
Add a notes field to the Lead data model for tracking payment conversations and general lead notes. Store as optional text field with no length restrictions.
